nodes.description: Public state variable 'owner' of type address, initialized to msg.sender at deployment time; used as the privileged address in the restricted modifier.
Public state variable 'last_completed_migration' of type uint; stores the migration index written by setCompleted.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the restricted modifier; writes the supplied value into last_completed_migration.
Caller-controlled address read both at construction (owner initialization) and inside the restricted modifier's require check.
Input parameter 'completed' of setCompleted; assigned directly into the last_completed_migration state variable.

edges.reason: The owner state variable is initialized directly from the untrusted msg.sender at deployment, making the privileged account caller-determined.
The restricted modifier requires msg.sender == owner before the body of setCompleted executes, so caller identity gates the state-changing function.
The parameter 'completed' is passed into the setCompleted function body.
The parameter 'completed' is written directly into the last_completed_migration state variable without further validation.
setCompleted performs a state write to last_completed_migration when called by the authorized owner.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter 'completed' has no independent security semantics; it is a plain input of setCompleted and should be merged into that core function node.
